dataQuality.intro: Each row counts the occurrence records that have a given property, out of all records matching the current filter. The bar shows the same share.
dataQuality.identifiedToSpecies: Identified to species: Records identified to a species after GBIF interpretation, meaning they have been matched to a species key. The original record might name a species, but if the name is not recognised it does not count.
dataQuality.withCollector: With collector: Records where the recordedBy field is filled in. A value such as "no collector" is not treated as missing.

occurrenceSummary.occurrenceRecords: Occurrence records: The number of occurrence records matching the current filter.
occurrenceSummary.species: Species: The number of distinct species keys after interpretation. A name that is not recognised does not add a species.
occurrenceSummary.yearRange: Year range: The earliest and latest value in the year field of the matching records. This is the year field, not the eventDate field.

sequencePhylogeny.about.label: How this tree is built
sequencePhylogeny.about.title: How this tree is built
sequencePhylogeny.about.align: The distinct nucleotide sequences of the matching occurrences are aligned using <k>kalign</k> (a multiple sequence alignment tool).
sequencePhylogeny.about.tree: Pairwise genetic distances (p-distance, ignoring gaps and ambiguous sites) are read from that alignment, and a neighbour-joining tree is built from them. Near-zero internal branches are shown as multifurcations rather than an arbitrary ladder.
sequencePhylogeny.about.collapse: The collapse slider merges sequences that are at least the chosen % identical into a single tip. Tips are labelled by the consensus taxon of the sequences they represent.
sequencePhylogeny.about.downloads: Downloads reflect the current view: the full alignment (<fasta>FASTA</fasta>) and the tree (<newick>Newick</newick>, at the current collapse level).
